quote: Everybody has plans until they get hit for the first time.
source: Reply to Tyrell Biggs's fight prediction, Associated Press, 19 Aug 1987
note: The famous 'punched in the mouth' wording came later. This is what he actually said.

quote: My style is impetuous, my defense is impregnable, and I'm just ferocious. I want your heart. I want to eat his children. Praise be to Allah.
source: Jim Gray interview after the Savarese fight, Glasgow, 24 June 2000
note: The fight lasted 38 seconds. Lennox Lewis, whose children he wanted to eat, had none.

quote: Real freedom is having nothing. I was freer when I didn't have a cent.
source: Sports Illustrated, 1988
note: He was 21 and the undisputed heavyweight champion of the world.

quote: I'll never be happy. I believe I'll die alone. I would want it that way.
source: USA Today interview, 2 June 2005
note: Said nine days before his last professional fight.

quote: The man who views the world at 50 the same as he did at 20 has wasted 30 years of his life.
source: Playboy interview, November 1975

quote: It's just a job. Grass grows, birds fly, waves pound the sand. I beat people up.
source: Quoted by BBC Sport, 2007
note: He also wrote poetry, mostly about how pretty he was.

quote: Frazier is so ugly that he should donate his face to the US Bureau of Wildlife.
source: On Joe Frazier, quoted by BBC Sport, 2007
note: Frazier never really forgave him.

quote: I really didn't say everything I said.
source: The Yogi Book (1997), p. 9
note: It is also the book's subtitle.

quote: We made too many of the wrong mistakes.
source: Hy Gardner column, New York Herald Tribune, 29 Feb 1960

quote: If the world were perfect, it wouldn't be.
source: When You Come to a Fork in the Road, Take It! (2002), p. 154

quote: It gets late early out there.
source: On Yankee Stadium's left field in autumn; What Time Is It? You Mean Now? (2003)
note: He meant the shadows. Probably.

quote: I got hurt on company time, so I'll heal on company time.
source: On sitting out with an ankle injury, NBCSports.com, 12 Dec 2005

quote: I was going to sue her for defamation of character, but then I realized that I have no character.
source: On Tonya Harding, Sports Illustrated, 7 Feb 1994
note: Harding had called herself 'the Charles Barkley of figure skating'.

quote: I don't know anything about Angola, but Angola's in trouble.
source: Press conference before USA vs Angola, Barcelona Olympics, 1992
note: The Dream Team won 116-48. He elbowed an Angolan in the chest anyway.

quote: You can't start a diet in the middle of the week, that's just stupid.
source: The Jay Leno Show, November 2009

quote: I went left, he went left. I went right, he went right. I went left again, he went to buy a hot dog.
source: On defender Stephane Henchoz, quoted in Simon Kuper's The Football Men (2011)

quote: What Carew does with a football, I can do with an orange.
source: Reply to Norway striker John Carew, VG, April 2002
note: Carew had called his tricks 'pointless'.

quote: If you drive a Ferrari you put premium petrol in the tank, you hit the motorway and you step on the gas. Guardiola filled up with diesel and took a spin in the countryside. He should have bought a Fiat.
source: I Am Zlatan (2011), on his season under Pep Guardiola at Barcelona
note: The sentence before it: 'When you buy me, you are buying a Ferrari.'

quote: Someone said to me 'To you football is a matter of life or death!' and I said 'Listen, it's more important than that'.
source: Granada TV interview with Shelley Rohde, 20 May 1981
note: The usual 'much, much more important' version is a paraphrase.

quote: When the seagulls follow the trawler, it is because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea.
source: Statement to the press after his assault appeal, 31 March 1995
note: His entire statement. He then stood up and left.

quote: Me and Jesus are cool. I'm cool with all the gods. Gods recognize gods.
source: UFC 197 press conference, Las Vegas, 20 Jan 2016
note: A Texas pastor subsequently prayed, on camera, for God to smite him.

quote: I am cocky in prediction, I am confident in preparation but I am always humble in victory or defeat.
source: UFC 178 post-fight press conference, 27 Sept 2014

quote: Avoid fried meats which angry up the blood.

answer.name: Satchel Paige
answer.alias: The oldest rookie in Major League history

source: 'How to Stay Young', Collier's, 13 June 1953
note: Rule one of six. Rule six: don't look back, something might be gaining on you.

quote: There ain't no man can avoid being born average. But there ain't no man got to be common.
source: Lincoln Evening Journal, 26 July 1958

quote: Strength does not come from winning. Your struggles develop your strengths.
source: Interview with Marian Christy, Boston Globe, 9 May 1982

quote: The whole concept of the self-made man or woman is a myth.
source: University of Houston commencement speech, 15 May 2017
note: From a man who arrived in America with a gym bag and became governor.

quote: It's as satisfying to me as cumming is, as having sex with a woman and cumming.
source: Pumping Iron (1977)
note: He is describing 'the pump': blood rushing into a muscle you have just trained.

quote: I don't make mistakes. I make prophecies that immediately turn out to be wrong.

answer.name: Murray Walker
answer.alias: The voice of BBC Formula One commentary for decades

source: Gold Coast Bulletin, 26 Oct 2002

quote: If you no longer go for a gap that exists, you are no longer a racing driver.
source: Interview with Jackie Stewart, Australian Grand Prix, November 1990
note: Stewart had just asked why he kept crashing into people.

quote: I object to being called a chess genius because I consider myself to be an all around genius who just happens to play chess...
source: Radio interview, 6 July 2001

quote: I don't keep any close friends. I don't keep any secrets. I don't need friends. I just tell everybody everything, that's all.
source: Interview with Ralph Ginzburg, Harper's, January 1962
note: He was 18.

quote: Hitler didn't snub me; it was our president who snubbed me. The president didn't even send me a telegram.
source: On Franklin Roosevelt; quoted in Jeremy Schaap, Triumph (2007), p. 211

quote: I had four gold medals, but you can't eat four gold medals.
source: Interview, 1971 (ESPN SportsCentury, 2005)
note: He later raced against horses for money.

quote: I spent a lot of money on booze, birds and fast cars. The rest I just squandered.

answer.name: George Best
answer.alias: The footballer the Portuguese press nicknamed 'El Beatle'

source: Quoted in BBC News, 14 June 2005

quote: Gentlemen, we are going to relentlessly chase perfection, knowing full well we will not catch it, because nothing is perfect.

answer.name: Vince Lombardi
answer.alias: The coach the Super Bowl trophy is named after

source: First team meeting as Green Bay Packers coach, 1959

quote: Can't anybody here play this game?

answer.name: Casey Stengel
answer.alias: The manager of the 1962 Mets, who lost 120 games

source: On the 1962 Mets; Jimmy Breslin, Can't Anybody Here Play This Game? (1963)

quote: As long as you don't say nuthin' they don't know whether you're smart or dumb.
source: Bennett Cerf, 'Try and Stop Me' column, 1964

quote: Please do not call me arrogant because what I'm saying is true. I'm European champion, so I'm not one out of the bottle; I think I'm a special one.
source: First Chelsea press conference, 2 June 2004
note: The press trimmed it to 'The Special One'. He has never objected.

quote: I prefer not to speak. If I speak, I am in big trouble.
source: Press conference after Chelsea v Aston Villa, 15 March 2014
note: He then said it again. And again.

quote: I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
source: Nike 'Failure' commercial, 1997
note: The ad's tally: 9,000 missed shots, 300 lost games, 26 missed game-winners.

quote: Hard times are when a man has worked at a job for thirty years—THIRTY YEARS—and they give him a watch, kick him in the butt and say 'hey a computer took your place daddy,' that's hard times!

answer.name: Dusty Rhodes
answer.alias: The 300-pound wrestler billed as 'the son of a plumber'

source: 'Hard Times' promo, NWA Mid-Atlantic Championship Wrestling, 29 Oct 1985
note: The speech was setting up a cage match with Ric Flair.

quote: Load the spaceship with the rocket fuel!

answer.name: Ultimate Warrior
answer.alias: The face-painted WWF champion billed from 'Parts Unknown'

source: WWF television promo, early 1990s (collected by Complex, 2014)

quote: I'm supposed to be the franchise player and we're in here talking about practice.
source: Philadelphia 76ers press conference, 7 May 2002
note: He said 'practice' roughly twenty times in a few minutes.

quote: I'm just here so I won't get fined.

answer.name: Marshawn Lynch
answer.alias: The running back nicknamed Beast Mode

source: Super Bowl XLIX Media Day, 27 Jan 2015
note: He said it 29 times in four minutes and 51 seconds, then left.

quote: This is not even a conspiracy theory. The Earth is flat.
source: 'Road Trippin'' podcast, 17 Feb 2017
note: The NBA commissioner later confirmed that he personally believes the world is round.

quote: We're gonna win the game. I guarantee it.

answer.name: Joe Namath
answer.alias: The quarterback who modelled pantyhose in a 1974 TV ad

source: Miami Touchdown Club banquet, 9 Jan 1969 (unrecorded; wording per Namath)
note: The Jets were 18-point underdogs in Super Bowl III. They won 16-7.

quote: Playoffs? Don't talk about -- playoffs? You kidding me? Playoffs? I just hope we can win a game!

answer.name: Jim Mora
answer.alias: Head coach of the 4-6 Indianapolis Colts, November 2001

source: Colts press conference after a 40-21 loss to the 49ers, 25 Nov 2001
note: The Colts did not make the playoffs. Mora was fired.

quote: When Alexander of Macedonia was 33, he cried salt tears because there were no more worlds to conquer... Bristow's only 27.

answer.name: Sid Waddell
answer.alias: The voice of televised darts

source: BBC commentary on Eric Bristow winning the world darts title, mid-1980s

quote: Leave me alone. I know what I'm doing.

answer.name: Kimi Räikkönen
answer.alias: The Formula One world champion nicknamed 'The Iceman'

source: Team radio while leading the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix, 4 Nov 2012
note: He won. The team printed it on T-shirts.

quote: Through the power of prayer, through the power of gratitude, they managed to turn the most toxic food, or maybe most polluted water into the most healing water, because water reacts.
source: Instagram Live with wellness guru Chervin Jafarieh, May 2020
note: He was world number one at the time. Water does not, for the record, react.

quote: Let the women play in more feminine clothes like they do in volleyball. They could, for example, have tighter shorts.

answer.name: Sepp Blatter
answer.alias: The FIFA president later banned from football for ethics breaches

source: Interview with SonntagsBlick (Switzerland), January 2004

quote: I will love it if we beat them. Love it.
source: Live Sky Sports interview after Leeds 0-1 Newcastle, 29 April 1996
note: They did not beat them. Manchester United won the league.

quote: You sit there and you thump your Bible, and you say your prayers, and it didn't get you anywhere.
source: Promo after winning King of the Ring, Milwaukee, 23 June 1996
note: Said to Jake 'The Snake' Roberts, followed by 'Austin 3:16 says I just whipped your ass!'

quote: Yes, that's correct, twenty thousand different ladies. At my age, that equals out to having sex with 1.2 women a day, every day since I was fifteen years old.

answer.name: Wilt Chamberlain
answer.alias: The man who scored 100 points in an NBA game

source: A View from Above (1991)
note: Even Charlie Sheen said he didn't believe him.

quote: I play tennis for a living even though I hate tennis, hate it with a dark and secret passion and always have.
source: Open: An Autobiography (2009), page 1
note: He won eight Grand Slam titles while hating it.

quote: Everybody wants to be a bodybuilder, but don't nobody want to lift no heavy-ass weights!

answer.name: Ronnie Coleman
answer.alias: The eight-time Mr. Olympia who moonlighted as a police officer

source: Ronnie Coleman: The Unbelievable (training video, 2000)
note: Said before a 540-pound T-bar row.

quote: I wanted them to have something in common ... I tell them if one goes up, we all go up.

answer.name: George Foreman
answer.alias: The heavyweight champion who sold 100 million grills

source: On naming all five sons George; In Depth with Graham Bensinger, 2021
note: His daughters include Freeda George and Georgetta.

quote: I definitely want Brooklyn to be christened - but I don't know into what religion yet.
source: Interview c. 1999, as reported by the Irish Examiner, 2 April 2002
note: A Bradford vicar wrote to him suggesting he find a faith first.

quote: I'm not surprised, motherfuckers.
source: Octagon interview after beating Conor McGregor, UFC 196, 5 March 2016
note: He had taken the fight on eleven days' notice.

quote: I wouldn't say I was the best manager in the business. But I was in the top one.

answer.name: Brian Clough
answer.alias: The manager who won two European Cups with Nottingham Forest

source: Regional TV interview, early 1990s (quoted by Sporting Life, 2019)

quote: If God had wanted us to play football in the clouds, he'd have put grass up there.
source: Quoted in Match of the Day's 1993 tribute (Sporting Life, 2019)

quote: See, normally if you go one on one with another wrestler, you got a 50/50 chance of winning. But I'm a genetic freak and I'm not normal! So you got a 25%, AT BEST, at beat me.

answer.name: Scott Steiner
answer.alias: The wrestler who did Steiner Math

source: 'Steiner Math' promo, TNA Impact, 1 May 2008
note: He concluded he had a 141 2/3% chance of winning. Samoa Joe won.

quote: To be the man, you gotta beat the man.

answer.name: Ric Flair
answer.alias: The 16-time world champion known as 'The Nature Boy'

source: Signature promo line, NWA/WCW television, 1980s (collected by AJC, 2017)

quote: He's a good guy to me. Guess what? He's my friend.
source: On Kim Jong Un, ABC's This Week, 3 March 2013
note: Days earlier in Pyongyang he had told Kim: 'You have a friend for life.'

quote: Man, I should have gotten a gold medal for all that chowing down.

answer.name: Usain Bolt
answer.alias: The fastest man in recorded history

source: Faster Than Lightning (2013), on his Beijing 2008 diet
note: He estimates he ate about 1,000 Chicken McNuggets in ten days. He won three golds.

quote: This is so corny. This is so dumb. I hate it. This is the most corny thing I've ever done.

answer.name: Nancy Kerrigan
answer.alias: The figure skater who was clubbed on the knee in 1994

source: Hot mic at a Walt Disney World parade; Seattle Times, 2 March 1994
note: She was riding next to Mickey Mouse, wearing her Olympic silver medal.

quote: I'm not going to the fucking White House.
source: Eight by Eight video interview, recorded Jan 2019, published 25 June 2019
note: Trump tweeted that she should 'WIN first before she TALKS'. She won.

quote: Just because my body was developed for a purpose other than fucking millionaires doesn't mean it's masculine.
source: UFC 190 Embedded, episode 2, 29 July 2015
note: Beyoncé later played the speech on tour.
